page.notes: Greek passages are only partly legible at this scan resolution and are transcribed with best reading; treat the Greek words as doubtful throughout, especially the accented forms and the words after "Ἀείσατο", "Ἀρχαῖοι" and "ἐπινοσθος". Long s is rendered as plain s throughout, including "est" and "discus", since the printed f-form stands for s. The faint "actu" at the right edge of the text block is show-through and is omitted. The line "Epodus 4. versuum 9." is read as a verse reference set apart and given level 3.
